scripts.dev:safe: npm run preflight:spawn && npm run dev
scripts.build:safe: npm run preflight:spawn && npm run build
scripts.preflight: npm run preflight:spawn && npm run preflight:locks
scripts.verify:ops: npm run verify && npm run ops:env:check && npm run ops:smoke
scripts.verify: npm run build:prepare && npm run text:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.verify:safe: npm run preflight:spawn && npm run preflight:locks && npm run text:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build:prepare
scripts.verify:safe:strict: npm run preflight:spawn && npm run preflight:locks && npm run text:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build:prepare:strict
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.prisma:generate:sqlite: node scripts/render-prisma-schema.mjs sqlite && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate:postgres: node scripts/render-prisma-schema.mjs postgresql && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:init && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:push:sqlite: node scripts/render-prisma-schema.mjs sqlite && prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma
scripts.db:push:postgres: node scripts/render-prisma-schema.mjs postgresql && prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma
